summary: Solo hiker triggered an avalanche on East S. Arapahoe Peak (south of South Arapaho Peak) in the Indian Peaks Wilderness ~10:30 a.m. — postholed ~4 ft of drifted snow, watched the fracture above and east, was swept over several cliffs and carried ~150 vertical ft; suffered cuts, bruises, and a fractured pelvis; self-evacuated and drove himself to a hospital. RMRG documented the incident (no field response); the climber credits Wilderness First Responder training.
location: East S. Arapahoe Peak, south of South Arapaho Peak, Indian Peaks Wilderness
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group (documented; subject self-evacuated — no field response)
notes: Date 2018-10-15 per the linked CAIC accident report (2018/10/15 — Monday-verified); paraphrased from the parent-opened UN article.
